campus.address: 1732 Deogyeong-daero, Giheung-gu, Yongin-si, Gyeonggi-do 17104, Republic of Korea

datasets.name: FABDEM V1-2 (tile N37E127)
datasets.role: Primary terrain: bare-earth DTM with forests and buildings removed
datasets.date: Copernicus GLO-30 source data 2011–2015; FABDEM released 2022 (V1-2 2023)
datasets.limitations: Machine-learning bare-earth correction; errors of metres, larger under dense forest and on steep slopes. Cannot resolve terraces or walls narrower than ~30 m.

datasets.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (tile N37E127)
datasets.role: DSM for cross-checks and the canopy-height model that guides vegetation
datasets.provider: ESA / DLR / Airbus via AWS Open Data
datasets.limitations: Published spec: absolute vertical accuracy < 4 m (LE90). It is a surface model. Buildings in this area appear strongly under-represented.

datasets.name: OpenStreetMap
datasets.role: Campus boundary, building footprints/names/levels, roads, paths, steps, parking, landcover, POIs
datasets.limitations: Volunteered geometry; positional accuracy not quantified (typically 1–5 m). Heights missing for most campus buildings.

datasets.name: Kyung Hee University official campus map list
datasets.role: Building names and numbering for verification (33 entries)
datasets.license: © Kyung Hee University (names used for identification)
datasets.limitations: No coordinates, floor counts or English names on the pages.

datasets.name: EGM2008 geoid (PROJ us_nga_egm08_25)
datasets.limitations: N varies only 0.45 m over the window; residual interpolation error < 1 cm.

datasets.name: Stylised campus appearance (this project)
datasets.role: Procedural facades, main-gate model, amphitheatre terraces, observatory dome
datasets.limitations: Appearance only. Window layout, colours, gate form and gate heights are illustrative, not surveyed.

datasets.name: Imagery tiles (Esri World Imagery default; Sentinel-2 cloudless, OSM, optional VWorld)
datasets.role: Draped surface texture only, never used to derive geometry
datasets.limitations: Third-party tiles; possible metre-level offsets and outdated capture dates.

checks.name: Campus terrain is not flat
checks.detail: Relief inside the boundary: 55.5–112.9 m (57.4 m), from 28746 DTM samples

checks.name: DTM vs mapped peak elevations (OSM ele)
checks.detail: n=3; mean Δ -2.24 m, max |Δ| 3.54 m (매미산 156.1 vs 158.5 m, 아람산 146.3 vs 147.1 m, 독침산 105.5 vs 109.0 m). A 30 m DEM is expected to slightly underestimate summits.

checks.name: DTM vs DSM agreement on open sports fields
checks.detail: n=950 samples; median DSM−DTM +0.46 m, RMS 1.61 m. This is an internal consistency check only (FABDEM is derived from Copernicus).

checks.name: Vertical datum handled (EGM2008 → WGS84 ellipsoid)
checks.detail: N = 23.34–23.79 m over the terrain window (EGM2008 via PROJ (us_nga_egm08_25)); this is added to every DTM height before rendering

checks.name: DEM grid registration
checks.detail: GeoTIFF GTRasterTypeGeoKey=PixelIsPoint; pixel (0,0) centre = 127.0°E, 38.0°N; 1″ spacing honoured without resampling

checks.name: Building footprint overlaps
checks.detail: 0 overlapping footprint pairs (>1 m²) among 1104 buildings

checks.name: Buildings on sloping ground
checks.detail: 23 of 41 campus buildings span >4 m of DTM relief. Their bases are set to the lowest ground point minus 1.5 m, so the uphill side is embedded in the slope and nothing floats.

checks.name: Campus building heights
checks.detail: In campus: 1 documented, 1 derived from floor count, 39 estimated. Whole scene: {'documented': 161, 'estimated': 936, 'derived': 7}. OSM and the official KHU pages do not publish heights for most campus buildings.

checks.name: DSM−DTM as height estimator (rejected)
checks.detail: Compared with 160 OSM-documented heights in the context area, Copernicus DSM minus FABDEM underestimated heights by about 45 m (r≈0.1), so it was not used.

checks.name: Official campus-map buildings matched to footprints
checks.detail: 23/24 official building entries matched to OSM footprints; unmatched: 한방재료가공(경희보감); matched but outside boundary: 0

checks.name: Campus buildings connected to the path network
checks.detail: 38/41 campus buildings lie within 30 m of a mapped road/footway (median 5.3 m)

checks.name: Stylised Kyung Hee building appearance
checks.detail: Campus buildings use their real footprints and DTM ground, but their facades (windows per estimated storey, colours) are procedural. Main gate: illustrative model on the footprint frame (59.24 × 5.54 m, opening 11.3 m from footprint vertices); its heights are estimated. Amphitheatre: 41 seating terraces sliced from the real DTM. None of this detail is surveyed.

checks.name: North orientation
checks.detail: All geometry is in geographic coordinates on the WGS84 globe, so north follows from the coordinates. There is no local rotation or scaling.

checks.name: Imagery ↔ footprint alignment
checks.detail: Checked visually in top-down screenshots (see docs/screenshots). Imagery comes from tile services; their offset relative to OSM is not quantified here.

trees.status: VISUAL APPROXIMATION - not surveyed tree positions
